topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I just found my old teddy bear here, of all places. This little, threadbare bear was my world when I was a kid. I thought I'd lost him for good when we moved years ago. The tags are worn, and one of his button eyes is missing, but he's still the same. I need to have him. I've been scanning the stalls, trying to find the seller, hoping they haven't packed him up yet. I have to get him back. It's like finding a piece of my childhood that I never knew I was missing. Please be here, please still be here.
